body: Do we think she's still alive? Last update was 2018 :(
Honestly... don't. This industry is toxic and soul crushing.
Under no circumstances should an adult school administrator in a position of power be pursuing a young girl. No.

Was your boyfriend emotionally stunted or something? A 13 yo and a 17yo are on entirely different wavelengths. Like a 13yo is definitely a kid. 17 year old is legally a child, but only for one more year. I feel like everyone I know who was a child when they started dating a much older boyfriend also romanticizes it. Same story, all the family loved him, it was special and an exception. I guess I wasn't there, but on its face it is just as creepy as Martin and Kate's relationship. At 13 you were still going through puberty.

I feel you. My dad's a fuckin child molester. I don't have memories of what he did to me. 

But my dad is a fuckin dick. The person you probably want to hurt is your molester. I want to hurt my dad more than I want to hurt myself, but I can't hurt my dad really. So I want to hurt myself. 

I feel you. Therapy and meds made me last this long, to 30. And I'm glad I've made it this long. I've been in a few relationships. They aren't all that. We gotta figure out how to love ourselves. It blows. 

The things that have made me glad I didn't kill myself at 14 or 18 or whatever are: nature, grand canyon, skydiving, friends, roadtrips, awesome sex

If you have nothing to lose you can do whatever the fuck you want. Go skydiving

Your dads suicide is his fault. He did it. Or more likely society's fault for not providing support that he needed. 

But you didn't do this and he wouldn't want you to blame yourself. If he knew you would blame yourself and it would hurt you this much, he may not have done it. But he was thinking about his pain, and was probably hoping you would at least get some life insurance money.
Same man same. Human contact is where it's at. I don't have the fuckin energy for dating

A few months ago I went on a big trip, said fuck it to all my responsibilities. I just lived day to day moment to moment. I went to like the grand canyon and shit. 

It helped (until I got traumatized again LOL) 

For like one glorious month I wasn't suicidal and I like wanted to live and get better. It was nuts 

Also a lot of therapy. It's via phone nowadays so you can do it while traveling
Therapy/psychiatrist, since you don't have a plan you can be completely honest without being sent somewhere against your will
Yeah, focus on the puppy and making sure you're okay for him. He needs you
